findings.issue: `with_snapshot()` retains every persisted observation, including rows after the requested run date, even though gross resolution applies an as-of cutoff. A historical/local build using an earlier `--date` can therefore calculate observed decay using future grosses and produce projections with look-ahead data.
findings.suggestion: Filter history observations to the applicable cutoff before adding today's snapshot and passing the series to projection.

findings.issue: History-axis dates are reconstructed only from positive-gross box-office rows. A degraded production refresh with zero resolved grosses leaves no durable record; after a later forecast refresh, that missing date disappears and the chart connects across it instead of preserving the required gap.
findings.suggestion: Persist every production refresh date independently of gross and forecast rows, then use those persisted dates to construct the history axis.
